_doc: Owner notifications (clearway/notify.py): each owner's targets. Two kinds. "webhook" (default): a JSON POST; here every owner also goes to the stand-in inbox on this machine (scripts/owner_inbox.py, http://127.0.0.1:8770/). A real webhook names the environment variable that holds its URL instead of the URL: "url_env": "CLEARWAY_HOOK_RAIL_CONTROL" (webhook URLs usually carry a credential, which stays out of this file), and optionally "secret_env" for the signing key. "ntfy": a push notification on the owner's phone through an ntfy topic (scripts/setup_ntfy.ps1 creates the topic names and the secret, stored in user-scope environment variables): url_env holds the topic URL, reply_url_env the topic the phone's Confirm / Reject buttons post to, secret_env the key that signs those buttons' tokens. Here every owner pushes to the same topic (one phone shows everything, the owner is in the title); give an owner its own by naming another variable, for example "url_env": "CLEARWAY_NTFY_URL_RAIL". "snapshot": true sends the JPEG of the spot along: camera footage leaves the machine with it.
